You are a programming expert. 
        You will be provided with a patch used to fix a bug. 
        Based on the commit message and modifications in the patch, you need to analyze the root cause of the bug in detail. 

        Here is the patch content:
        From 78947bdfd75211cc9482cad01f95fe103a863110 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Palmer Dabbelt <palmerdabbelt@google.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Mar 2021 22:01:04 -0700
Subject: [PATCH] RISC-V: kasan: Declare kasan_shallow_populate() static

Without this I get a missing prototype warning.

Reported-by: kernel test robot <lkp@intel.com>
Fixes: e178d670f251 ("riscv/kasan: add KASAN_VMALLOC support")
Cc: stable@vger.kernel.org
Signed-off-by: Palmer Dabbelt <palmerdabbelt@google.com>
---
 arch/riscv/mm/kasan_init.c | 2 +-
 1 file changed, 1 insertion(+), 1 deletion(-)

diff --git a/arch/riscv/mm/kasan_init.c b/arch/riscv/mm/kasan_init.c
index 5c35e0f71e88..4f85c6d0ddf8 100644
--- a/arch/riscv/mm/kasan_init.c
+++ b/arch/riscv/mm/kasan_init.c
@@ -155,7 +155,7 @@ static void __init kasan_populate(void *start, void *end)
 	memset(start, KASAN_SHADOW_INIT, end - start);
 }
 
-void __init kasan_shallow_populate(void *start, void *end)
+static void __init kasan_shallow_populate(void *start, void *end)
 {
 	unsigned long vaddr = (unsigned long)start & PAGE_MASK;
 	unsigned long vend = PAGE_ALIGN((unsigned long)end);
-- 
2.25.1


        
        Provide a response strictly in the following format:
        Root cause:<Root cause>

Root cause: The root cause of the bug was the lack of a static declaration for the function `kasan_shallow_populate()`, which led to a missing prototype warning during compilation. This warning indicates that the compiler could not find a declaration for the function before its usage, which can lead to potential issues with function linkage and visibility. By declaring the function as static, it restricts its visibility to the current translation unit, resolving the warning and ensuring proper function declaration and linkage.
